scope: ViMDoc OCR text and page identity for future BM25/BGE-M3/ColQwen2.5 score extraction

source_alignment.alignment_note: Use HEAVEN Tesseract plain-text OCR and final-underscore document mapping; add explicit versions, options, hashes and fail-closed errors for reproducibility.

asset_identity.path_safety: reject absolute, backslash, NUL, dot and dot-dot segments, links and duplicate member paths
asset_identity.page_id: filename with exactly one final allowed image extension removed
asset_identity.page_id_requirements: nonempty UTF-8 string; final underscore suffix is nonempty ASCII decimal digits
asset_identity.document_id: remove exactly the final underscore-delimited page-number suffix from page_id
asset_identity.same_page_id_same_content: collapse to one page; canonical asset path is UTF-8-byte-smallest path and all paths remain aliases
asset_identity.same_page_id_different_content: BLOCK; never prefer an extension, rename, average, or discard
asset_identity.same_content_different_page_id: retain every page identity and report cross-page duplicate-content groups

ocr.input: canonical asset selected only after page-identity audit passes
ocr.image_loading: Pillow Image.open; load; convert to RGB
ocr.timeout_policy: must be set by later resource calibration; timeout is an ERROR, never empty text
ocr.worker_policy: must be set by later resource calibration; scheduling must not change row order
ocr.text_normalization: replace CRLF and CR with LF only; preserve Unicode, whitespace and terminal newline; reject NUL
ocr.empty_text: valid SUCCESS_EMPTY result, retained and counted separately from errors
ocr.error_policy: zero OCR errors; record immutable failure and stop without emitting success marker
ocr.shared_text_requirement: BM25 and BGE-M3 must consume byte-identical normalized OCR text
ocr.visual_consumer: ColQwen2.5 consumes the same canonical image identity, not OCR text

required_future_evidence: Live archive SHA-256 equals the frozen dataset archive SHA-256.
Asset audit matches all expected counts and has zero different-content page-ID collisions.
Runtime manifest records exact OS image digest, installed package versions, tesseract --version and eng.traineddata SHA-256.
OCR contains exactly one successful row per canonical page and zero missing, extra, duplicate or ERROR rows.
Canonical asset and OCR JSONL hashes reproduce on a second read-only validation pass.
BM25 and BGE-M3 input manifests reference the same OCR JSONL SHA-256; ColQwen2.5 references the same canonical asset manifest SHA-256.
